author: Paula Ricardo
title: Traders Buy Apple (AAPL) on Weakness
text:
Traders Buy Apple (AAPL) on Weakness Posted by Paula Ricardo | Jul 12th, 2018
Traders purchased shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on weakness during trading hours on Tuesday. $545.40 million flowed into the stock on the tick-up and $467.37 million flowed out of the stock on the tick-down, for a money net flow of $78.03 million into the stock. Of all companies tracked, Apple had the 7th highest net in-flow for the day. Apple traded down ($0.23) for the day and closed at $190.35
AAPL has been the topic of several research analyst reports. Barclays reduced their price objective on Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an “equal weight” rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Rosenblatt Securities reissued a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, March 16th. Nomura reissued a “neutral” rating and set a $175.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, March 19th. Vetr raised Apple from a “buy” rating to a “strong-buy” rating and set a $191.57 price target on the stock in a research report on Friday, March 23rd. Finally, Bank of America reissued a “buy” rating and set a $220.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, March 23rd. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $208.11. Get Apple alerts:
The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80. The stock has a market capitalization of $965.84 billion, a PE ratio of 18.37, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.57 and a beta of 1.24.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $60.94 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm posted $2.10 EPS. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 earnings per share for the current year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has initiated a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that allows the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization allows the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are often a sign that the company’s board believes its stock is undervalued.
In other news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Monday, July 9th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the completion of the sale, the chief operating officer now owns 125,258 shares in the company, valued at $23,821,566.44. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at this link . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, April 13th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 207,860 shares of company stock valued at $38,080,999 in the last quarter. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
Institutional investors have recently made changes to their positions in the company. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter valued at $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter valued at $134,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter valued at $138,000. Macroview Investment Management LLC lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 220.3% in the first quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $151,000 after buying an additional 619 shares during the period. Finally, Oak Point Wealth Management purchased a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter valued at $163,000. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.07% of the company’s stock.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
